clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller guides new Horde shamans toward the spirits of the land and their first totems.

Canaga Earthcaller guides Darkspear trolls and orcs who begin the shaman’s path from the red bluffs of the Valley of Trials. He teaches newcomers to quiet their minds and listen to Kalimdor’s rumblings. They prepare earth sapta so they can commune with the spirits.

Canaga asks each novice to gather sacred reagents and travel to the local spirit rock in Durotar. There, they drink earth sapta and see the elemental spirits firsthand. Through his guidance, they earn their Earth Totem.
